description: Search live Reverb.com listings for musical gear — guitars, amps, pedals, synths, drums, pro audio. Returns asking prices with make, model, year, finish, condition grade and seller, filterable by category, price band, year range, condition, make and region. Prices are what sellers ARE ASKING, not what anything sold for: Reverb retired its public Price Guide, so no realized-sale data is available from this source.

category.description: Sub-category slug, e.g. "solid-body" — pairs with product_type

condition.description: Condition slug: new, b-stock, mint, excellent, very-good, good, fair, poor, non-functioning, used (used = any non-new grade)

currency.description: ISO currency for the price filters and returned prices (default USD)

item_region.description: Where the item ships FROM, e.g. "US", "GB", "EUR_EU"

page.description: 1-based page. Paging past `total_pages` still works — see `total_pages_note`.

price_min.description: Minimum price, in the currency given by `currency` (default USD)

product_type.description: Root category slug, e.g. "electric-guitars", "effects-and-pedals", "amps", "keyboards-and-synths", "drums-and-percussion". Call reverb_categories for the full list.

ships_to.description: Country code the item must ship to, e.g. "US"

name: reverb_search
title: Reverb Search
